title: Jetsuit (kinda)
description: Adds a jetsuit chestplate(command only) to make you able to vault, wall run on a honey block wall, speed you up and slow down your fall.
body:
/function #minecraft:load - get the jetsuit and load the datapack, if it didnt by itself.


Controls

Shift on the ground near a solid block(has to be on your eye level) to vault(get launched in the air)
Shift in the air to slow down your fall


Base movement speed with jetsuit on - 0.13
Sprinting movement speed with jetsuit on - 0.2

You get jump boost effect when wearing the jetsuit.


Jetsuit explodes in water(deals damage and destroys the item).

You can wall run on honey(stick to honey blocks and move)
